About

Packaging engineer by training, automation builder by necessity

Results-driven Operations Executive and Packaging Design Engineer with 3.7+ years across CKD export packaging, supply chain management, and automotive supply chain operations.

I manage end-to-end packaging for 1,400+ automotive parts a month across 10 CKD sets bound for Africa and Latin America, and lead CBU vehicle-stuffing that fits 4 Maruti Suzuki Dzire units into a single 40ft container — against the 3-vehicle standard most logistics providers use.

On the design side, I work in CATIA V5 for 2D/3D packaging and, being self-taught in Python, I've built the Streamlit dashboards, AppSheet workflows, and QR-based traceability tools that replaced our paper records with real-time, audit-ready data.

01 / Sole Developer

MIS Dashboard — Real-Time Packaging Operations Intelligence

DACO Engineering · Self-initiated & deployed
Live in production

A real-time Streamlit dashboard tracking part-wise receipt, inspection, and ESR completion across multiple production lots and 2,000+ parts per vehicle.

  • Automated daily MIS report generation and email delivery — saves roughly 20+ hours of manual reporting a month.

02 / Sole Developer

Container & Vehicle Loading Tracking Web App

DACO Engineering · Self-initiated & deployed
Live in production

A centralized digital system for end-to-end CBU vehicle loading and container tracking, replacing manual register entries for the packaging and dispatch team.

Project input & deployment: Gathered requirements from operations and dispatch users, mapped workflow needs, and deployed the application into day-to-day loading operations with user training and process support.

  • Auto-generates container and chassis numbers at the point of stuffing, removing manual entry errors and keeping every record unique and traceable.
  • Captures and stores loading photos against each container and chassis number for a full visual audit trail per dispatch.
  • One-click PDF and Excel export of loading records, container/chassis logs, and photo reports for clients, customs, and internal teams.
  • Supports multiple vehicles per container with model and discharge-port dropdowns, plus vehicle-dimension diagrams for CBU load planning.
  • Camera-based barcode/QR scanning and live multi-user sync so the loading team works off the same records in real time.
